title: Grid designs
summary: We define a grid graph $G$ as a Cartesian product of path-graphs $P_n$ or cycle-graphs $C_n$ as shown in Figure 1, and we ask, when can the edge set of a complete graph be expressed as a disjoint union of graphs isomorphic to $G$? That is, we are asking for which grid graphs a $G$-design exists, where a $G$-design is defined as a decomposition of a complete graph into edge-disjoint subgraphs isomorphic to $G$.
